off-by-one: recheck every loop bound against a size-1 example
verify < vs <= on each binary search branch
test the first and last index by hand
overflow: check types before submitting: int vs long long on every product
take mod after each multiplication, not at the end
estimate the max intermediate value on paper
missed edge case: list n=1, empty input, and max constraints before coding
run the sample plus one custom edge test
ask what breaks if all values are equal
wrong greedy: try to construct a counterexample before trusting the order
check whether sorting by a different key breaks it
consider whether dp is actually required
TLE: write the big-O first and multiply by the constraint
look for an O(n log n) replacement for the inner loop
check for accidental O(n^2) on already-sorted data
other: reread the statement for a missed condition
reproduce on the smallest failing case
explain the logic out loud before recoding
